intro: Sunday brings offline voice tools, compact speech synthesis and a deadline for older ARM workflows. BC investigations and wholesale figures lead the regional brief, with a piano recital, AI gathering and seasonal menus ahead.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen joins Copilot
stories.summary: GitHub is gradually rolling out Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen across paid Copilot plans, including CLI, coding agent and mobile clients. The Flash model targets fast tool use and multistep coding; Business and Enterprise administrators can manage access through model policies.

stories.title: ARM32 Actions jobs face December retirement
stories.summary: GitHub Actions hosted runners will end ARM32 job execution on Linux and Windows by December 8, including native AArch32 userspace execution. Maintainers targeting older hardware should review affected workflows: Node 24 does not support ARM32.

stories.title: Zyphra releases compact multilingual voice synthesis
stories.summary: Zyphra introduced ZONOS3-Mini, a speech-synthesis and voice-cloning model supporting 43 languages, with 100 million active parameters and 800 million total. Apache 2.0 weights give developers another option for evaluating local, controllable speech applications.

stories.title: Google adds offline voice to AI Edge Gallery
stories.summary: Google AI Edge Gallery now combines local speech recognition and synthesis with chat and language-teaching demonstrations. Developers can use ML Kit, MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT to build voice interfaces that transcribe speech and generate spoken replies offline.

stories.title: Abbotsford police seek hit-and-run footage
stories.summary: A black SUV struck a 63-year-old woman at Garibaldi Drive and Gladwin Road Friday evening, then left the scene, police say. Her injuries were not life-threatening; witnesses and drivers with dashcam footage can contact investigators at 604-859-5225.

stories.title: Four charged in Maple Ridge homicide
stories.summary: Investigators announced Saturday that four people face charges following a May 30 death at a River Road wharf. One faces first-degree murder and three face manslaughter; police describe the incident as targeted, with everyone known to each other.

stories.title: Wholesale gains disappear after adjusting for prices
stories.summary: Canadian wholesale sales rose 0.7% to $92.5 billion in September, excluding petroleum-related products, oilseed and grain, Statistics Canada reported Friday. Sales volumes fell 0.2%; third-quarter volumes also declined 0.2%, despite a rise in nominal sales.

events.date: 2026-11-22 · 3 p.m. · Vancouver Playhouse, 600 Hamilton Street, Vancouver
events.title: Saskia Giorgini pairs Chopin with Bonis and Boulanger
events.description: The pianist’s Sunday recital combines Chopin waltzes, mazurkas and Polonaise-Fantaisie with works by Mélanie Bonis, Lili Boulanger, Enescu and Debussy. Regular tickets range from $44 to $68; the society also lists reduced senior and student prices.

meetups.date: 2026-11-25 · 6–10 p.m. · H.R. MacMillan Space Centre, 1100 Chestnut Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: Vancouver AI puts human judgment on the agenda
meetups.description: Product designer Zoë Zaslow, AI visibility strategist Ashley Smith and composer Carl Faia lead the presentations. Doors open at six, with the program at seven; register for talks, questions and networking, and bring a design decision to discuss.

dining.date: December 2026 · UCHU, 158 East Pender Street, Vancouver
dining.title: UCHU adds December lunch and brunch
dining.description: UCHU expands into Thursday–Friday lunches and weekend brunch throughout December. Lunch includes ceviche and halibut-cheek sliders; brunch brings chicken anticucho with waffles and eggs Benedict with aji amarillo hollandaise. Both UCHU and SUYO will also open for Sunday dinners.

dining.date: 2026-11-15 · Bel Café, 801 West Georgia Street, Vancouver
dining.title: Bel refreshes sandwiches before holiday baking arrives
dining.description: Bel Café’s new chopped Italian and spicy turkey sandwiches join seasonal drinks and pastries, including an apple-mascarpone Danish. The downtown café opens eight to two on weekends; fruitcake, holiday cookies and additional seasonal treats arrive November 17.
